info.author: Luiz-Trindade
info.name: collections-cache
info.summary: Collection Cache is a Python package for managing data collections across multiple SQLite databases. It allows efficient storage, retrieval, and updating of key-value pairs, supporting various data types serialized with pickle. The package uses parallel processing for fast access and manipulation of large collections.
